content.comment_body: I'm working on automating a fish aquarium using a [product_name] since it includes two convenient analog inputs. My plan is to use these inputs to track temperature and pH levels. However, since my background is in IT, I have little experience in choosing suitable sensors for this setup. The aquarium should maintain a water temperature of 25°C and a pH close to 7.0. Ideally, I want to use sensors with a 0-10V output so that I don't need to buy an additional module. Any suggestions would be greatly appreciated.
For pH measurement, you can check out [url]. A current loop resistor can be used to convert to a 0-10V signal. For PT100 (temperature), there's an option for >0-10V conversion available at [url].

analysis.insight_summary: The user seeks guidance on selecting temperature and pH sensors that are compatible with the analog inputs of a [product_name] device for a fish aquarium automation project. The main concern is choosing 0-10V sensors to avoid the need for additional modules, highlighting the challenges faced by individuals who are new to sensor selection for specific use cases.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for clear recommendations for 0-10V temperature and pH sensors that will work with the analog inputs of the [product_name] module, and wishes to implement these solutions without requiring any extra hardware.
